description: This file defines a REST controller for managing driver entities in a fleet management system. It provides endpoints to list, retrieve, create, update, and delete drivers, utilizing Spring Boot annotations and OpenAPI specifications.

classes.name: DriverController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller managing driver-related API endpoints in a fleet management system.

methods.name: listDrivers
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of all drivers.

methods.name: getDriver
methods.description: Handles GET request to fetch a specific driver by ID.

methods.name: createDriver
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new driver, with validation.

methods.name: updateDriver
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing driver by ID.

methods.name: deleteDriver
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove a driver by ID.
